caption: the week ahead, jan 11 to jan 17: mercury in aquarius, mercury meets pluto, venus squares a retrograde mars.

slides.headline: this week, your *texts* get cooler and your crush gets louder
*venus* gets a little intense, in a good way
slides.body: astrologers read it as honest depth. a good night for the real conversation, not the third rerun.

slides.headline: *mercury* enters aquarius: think in big ideas
slides.body: it leaves capricorn for aquarius. read it as detached, inventive talk. great for ideas, rough on feelings.

slides.headline: mercury meets *pluto*: the conversation goes deep
slides.body: one day after mercury trines uranus. astrologers read the pluto meeting as the truth surfacing. ask, then listen.

slides.headline: first quarter in *aries*: push, but kindly
slides.body: the half moon reads as a decision point. same day, venus trines saturn: a good night to commit to something small.

slides.headline: *venus* squares a retrograde mars
slides.body: want and timing disagree. read it as a weekend to flirt, not to force. the slow answer is still an answer.

slides.headline: cool head, *warm heart*. you need both.
slides.body: save this for wednesday, when mercury changes sign.
